prompt: pulumi fully_qualified_stack_name diy backend org requirement
answer:
For a project-scoped DIY backend, the organization component of `fully_qualified_stack_name` must be the literal:

```text
organization
```

So the fully qualified form is:

```text
organization/<project>/<stack>
```

For example:

```text
organization/my-project/dev
```

This applies to new or upgraded project-scoped DIY backends. Legacy DIY backends do not support the `org/project/stack` format and use only the unqualified stack name.
